title: Mobility Equipment Warranty Terms — Failure-Timing Credit on a Kept Cash-Sale Chair
content:
# Failure-Timing Credit — Kept Cash-Sale Mobility Equipment Chairs

**Term.** On a Mobility Equipment chair sold for cash that the patient keeps, a failure-timing credit is added to the price adjustment by the days from the delivery date to the requested date of the chair's latest repair estimate request: 15.00 for no more than 7 days, 7.50 for more than 7 but no more than 21 days, and nothing for a longer span or no such request.

| Days from delivery to the latest repair estimate request | Failure-timing credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | 15.00 |
| 8 to 21 | 7.50 |
| 22 or more | nothing |
| no repair estimate request | nothing |

## Boundary pairs (hypothetical, chair delivered 2 July)

- Latest repair estimate requested 9 July (7 days): 15.00; requested 10 July (8 days): 7.50.
- Requested 23 July (21 days): 7.50; requested 24 July (22 days): nothing.

The latest repair estimate request is the latest by requested date; the delivery date is the one on the chair's wheelchair record.
